node.title: Re^3: copyCurrentNode in XML::LibXML::Reader will add xmlns attribute ( setNamespaceDeclURI )
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Thanks, despite being marked "experimental" it does appear to work in the OP's case:

use warnings; use strict; use XML::LibXML::Reader; my $xml = <<'ENDXML'; ENDXML my $reader = XML::LibXML::Reader->new(string => $xml); while ($reader->read) { my $node = $reader->copyCurrentNode; $node->setNamespaceDeclURI(undef, undef) if $node->nodeName eq 'bar'; print "$node"; } __END__

Unfortunately I might still be missing something, because applied to [choroba]'s code [id://1193600|here] it doesn't seem to change the namespace of the nodes.
